Both 35/35 deadline misses (mean complete update ~8.51 s at 0.01 s period; real_time_demonstrated false) — a timing failure independent of holding. Zero force-bound violations does not exclude legal near-bound input. Against the selected .05/.05 incumbent (batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0), BOTH candidates deteriorate holding error and speed at frozen tolerances; -1 is a physical tradeoff with better terminal error (-5.58e-6 m) — distinct from the improvement both show only against the earlier failing retained baseline (issue 5).

This does not falsify the whole interval as a boundary, and no continuous threshold or monotonic law is validated. Non-monotonicity is an observation, not a mechanism; a two-point batch describes only tested candidates.

Candidate disposition: retain the accepted .05/.05 incumbent (batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0); no promotion — -0 fails acceptance and -1 is a tradeoff. M4 closed, M5 overall open. Accepted operational next action: none in this grant — close the substage with incumbent retained, zero future budget, route stop (issue 6)."
